    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    FabricClientEvents
    Feeds Fabric interaction callbacks into the shared gesture classifier.
    FabricClientNetworking
    Fabric client receivers and the packet sender used by the shared gesture rules.
    FabricClientRendering
    Fabric renderer, reload-listener, and measured-cache registration.
    FabricEditAuthority
    Pure destination permission queries through Common Protection API, followed by Fabric's native block-break lifecycle.
    FabricItemStorage
    Registers whole-run item storages for all three Fabric block entity types.
    FabricKeyMappings
    Fabric registration for the shared gesture modifier.
    FabricNetworking
    Fabric payload registration and server receivers around the shared packet codecs and handlers.
    FabricPlatformServices
    Fabric implementations of the common platform services.
    FabricRegistry
    Fabric registration for the shared blocks and block entities.
    FabricRunItemStorage
    Fabric Transfer API view over a complete Storage pile, Singles column, or Bar column.
    FabricStackInteractionEvents
    Applies Some Stacks gestures from Fabric's actual server-side block-use callback.
    JsonServerConfig
    Fabric's server-policy persistence: per-world JSON at <world>/serverconfig/somestacks-server.json, reread by /ss reload.
    ProtocolPkt
    Fabric-only configuration-phase registration marker used to require a compatible peer.
    SomeStacksFabric
    Fabric's common entry point and server lifecycle wiring.
    SomeStacksFabricClient
    Fabric's client entry point.
